Let’s break it down step by step.  

1. Start with the innermost parentheses:  
   \( \text{True and False} \) → \( \text{False} \)  

2. Apply the triple “not”:  
   \( \text{not False} \) → \( \text{True} \)  
   \( \text{not True} \) → \( \text{False} \)  
   \( \text{not False} \) → \( \text{True} \)  

So \( \text{not not not (True and False)} \) → \( \text{True} \).  

Final answer: true
